lines.zh: 六条腿轮流落地，背上的帆一晃。
lines.en: Six legs land in turn and the sail on my back sways.

lines.zh: 我走得稳，帆却一直在动。
lines.en: My gait is steady while the sail keeps moving.
I cross the grass slope sideways.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子伸在前头，探路。
lines.en: My snout goes ahead to test the way.
I go round that thorny clump.
I step and halt as if listening.
The sail opens a little to regulate my heat.

lines.zh: 我踩着小石子，脚下有声。
lines.en: Loose pebbles sound under my feet.
I make my way slowly toward the water.
I keep to the middle of the herd.

lines.zh: 我转身，帆跟着偏了一边。
lines.en: I turn and the sail lists to one side.

lines.zh: 我走过一处浅坑，步幅变短。
lines.en: I cross a shallow dip with shorter steps.

lines.zh: 我的帆随步子一开一合。
lines.en: My sail opens and closes with each step.

lines.zh: 我沿着树影走，避开太阳。
lines.en: I walk in the tree shadows away from the sun.
I stop and wait for you to catch up.
I work my way up the little slope.

lines.zh: 我站着，背上的帆轻轻张合。
lines.en: I stand and the sail on my back opens and closes.
Wind crosses the sail with a low sound.
I rest my snout on a forelimb.

lines.zh: 帆上的热，暖进我的背里。
lines.en: The warmth on my sail seeps into my back.
I hold still, but the sail keeps moving.
It's cool beneath my sail; I stay put.
My six legs stand wide apart.
I turn my body toward the sun.
The veins on my sail show clearly.
My nose huffs out a note.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻自己的脚。
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff my own foot.
The wind dies and the sail lowers.

lines.zh: 我盯着草尖看了一会儿。
lines.en: I watch a grass tip a while.
I close my eyes once.
I scratch my belly with a hind leg.
I've chewed a long while and still haven't swallowed.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，帆也竖了起来。
lines.en: I raise my head and the sail lifts too.

lines.zh: 你袖口沾着别的兽毛，我闻到了。
lines.en: There's another beast's hair on your cuff; I smell it.
I push my snout toward you.
I tilt my head and judge you.

lines.zh: 你比我的腿高不了多少。
lines.en: You are barely taller than my legs.
I take half a step toward you.
I watch you long and do not retreat.
Your shadow falls on my sail.
I snort and the grass sways.
If you reach out, I will not dodge.

lines.zh: 我把头低了低，算是应了。
lines.en: I dip my head, which counts as assent.
We look at each other across a stretch of grass.

lines.zh: 我叫了两声，往后撤两步。
lines.en: I bleat twice and pull back two steps.
That lands on my leg.
All six legs are trembling.

lines.zh: 我缩起头，帆也收了一半。
lines.en: I tuck my head and the sail half folds.
It hurts, and I can still stand.
I drag myself into the grass.
Blood runs down my leg.
I push myself up little by little.

lines.zh: 这一击我记在背甲纹里。
lines.en: I keep that in the grain of my shell.
Four legs can still hold me.
One sniff and I come over.
You offer grass and I lower my head.
This handful is tender.
I chew slowly and never stop.
Hold your hand steady; I fear biting it.
Done, I lift my head to you.
I eat while watching around.
You take a few steps and I take as many.
My snout is nearly touching you.
A little more and I will stay here.
I curl the grass away with my lips.
Green froth rings my mouth.
When you move, my head comes up.
I taste the dew; this grass is sweet.
Finished, I lick my snout.
Step back, and then I'll dare to reach.

lines.zh: 你撞在我侧面，我晃了晃帆。
lines.en: You hit my flank and the sail wobbles.

lines.zh: 我六条腿一撑，没被推翻。
lines.en: All six legs brace and I stay up.
I shift half a step to let you by.
I lurch and catch myself.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的帆，它弹了一下。
lines.en: You touch my sail and it springs.
I lower my eyes at you.
This crowded, my legs cannot turn.
I back into the grass.

lines.zh: 你撞得我的帆歪向一边。
lines.en: Your bump knocks my sail to one side.
I butt you once.
Our two snouts meet.
It rubs past my neck.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，帆一高一低。
lines.en: We walk abreast, sails rising and falling.
I walk a circle around it.
It shifts and I shift.
We bite the same grass stem.
It strayed from the herd and I called.
We doze pressed together.
My chin presses on its shell rim.
Our sails touch and part.
I take up a mouthful of grass.
I curl a leaf with my lips.
It won't snap; I pin it with a foreleg.
I dip and bite through the root.
I pull the clump up by its roots.
My mouth bulges full.
I spit it out; the taste is wrong.
I swallow the grass mouthful by mouthful.
This one has soil on it, so I shake it.
The stalk's tough; I chew and chew.
The grass stirs and my head comes up.
That outline has entered my eye.
My sail opens and I look larger.
I call low and the herd hears it.
It is too close.
I lower my snout and point it at it.
The wind is wrong, so I move.
I scrape at the soil with a forelimb.
I step ahead of my herdmate.
Once locked on, I stop grazing.

lines.zh: 我绕着它走，帆一直冲着它。
lines.en: I circle it, my sail always facing it.
It loops and I turn slowly.
I do not run; running is worse.
I back into the grass step by step.
It steps in and I sink a little.
My sail stays open and I dare not lower it.
We hold at a standstill.
It tries my back and I turn first.
All my legs are taut.
Any nearer and I butt.
I lower my head and butt.
I butt with my shoulder rim.
My forelimbs smack its knees.
That shove drives it back.
I bite the top of its foot.
It slashes and I take it on the shoulder.
I butt again, heavier than before.
It retreats and I hold.

lines.zh: 帆张到最开，我显得很大。
lines.en: The sail opens wide and I look huge.
When I stop, I sink low and pant.

lines.zh: 我从草里站起来，帆慢慢张开。
lines.en: I rise from the grass and the sail spreads.
Six legs brace on loose soil.
The grass here is thick enough.
I dip first for a mouthful of grass.
Herdmates come over the rise.

lines.zh: 风从侧面吹，我把帆转开。
lines.en: Wind on my flank and I turn the sail.

lines.zh: 我从蕨丛里钻出来，抖了抖帆。
lines.en: I push out of the ferns and shake my sail.
The soil is loose under me.
I shift toward the noise.
It is quiet here and I look slowly.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的帆，我甩着头躲。
lines.en: Fire catches my sail and I shake my head to escape.

lines.zh: 落地时六条腿一起撑住。
lines.en: All six legs brace on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我使劲抬头。
lines.en: Water fills my snout and I strain upward.

lines.zh: 炸风把帆掀翻盖住我的头。
lines.en: The blast flips my sail over my head.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进帆面，我扭头去咬。
lines.en: Something pierces my sail and I twist to bite it.

lines.zh: 冷意钻进皮下，我浑身一抖。
lines.en: Cold seeps under my hide and I shudder.
Too hungry to raise my head.

lines.zh: 雷打在帆上，我全身都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my sail and numbs me all over.
There is no ground beneath.
